payload.meaning: A staff envelope read from stdin needs a nonempty object payload. No one property is required across the operation forms. Send saved values in a provider-map wrapper; a flat save map would also include a control key that its key validator refuses.

args.meaning: Operation vector read from the envelope payload, not independently from argv. A nonempty all-string vector is parsed before verb and can select status or save, with the parser's ordinary -- end-of-options separator. An empty vector falls through to verb. For a mixed-type vector only, the first item is used when verb is absent.

verb.meaning: Fallback operation: save selects a write; all other values leave the status read. A parsed nonempty all-string args vector takes precedence.

keys.meaning: First provider map considered for save. Only the two supported names may appear; an empty string removes a configured value.

THEGAMESDB_API_KEY.meaning: TheGamesDB provider value, supplied through stdin only.

SCREENSCRAPER_API_KEY.meaning: Screenscraper provider value, supplied through stdin only.

providers.meaning: Alias of keys with the same allowed entries, used if keys is not an object.

metadata.meaning: Alias of keys with the same allowed entries, used if neither keys nor providers is an object.

path.meaning: Provider configuration file, not its contents.

configured.meaning: In status, one presence boolean per supported provider key.

configured_names.meaning: Names with a nonempty value; no key material.

mode.meaning: Status reports observed octal mode or null when absent; save reports 0600.

changed.meaning: On save, whether the new text differs from the former file; save also enforces mode 0600.

preserved_existing.meaning: On save, values for unsubmitted providers were retained.

mutationPerformed.meaning: True after replacing the file, false on a status read or reported intake failure.

error.meaning: Intake, validation or file error text. Most such failures have no firstMissingSignal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Named argument or empty-envelope-payload refusal; no token is added on success.
